title: Midnight French Tagine Sausage Curry
description: A hearty and flavorful Indian-inspired curry made with French sausages and a tagine spice blend, perfect for satisfying late-night cravings.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the French sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Return the sausages to the pot and stir in the coconut milk.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the sausages are cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
